verdict.rationale: Synthesia publishes a documented public API at docs.synthesia.io. It covers a Video API for scripted avatar videos, translation and templates, plus Upload, Billing and Localization APIs, an Interactive Avatars API, and webhooks. A quickstart covers async job submission, polling and download, and a probe confirmed the docs site and an API-focused llms.txt are live. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the API working as documented (the community item is about avatar quality, not the API).
